🔔 FTZ SPEED KING4 SS3 Major Update] 

---

🚀 **What you'll find on this map:** 
🏍️ A fast, fun, and powerful motorcycle! 
🌟 Such a cool system! So realistic! 
👥 Have fun with lots of new friends! 

---

Supports **PC 🖥️ and mobile devices 📱**

💻 **Control (for PC)** 
• Shift up: **E**
• Shift down: **Q**
• Change gear type: **M**
• First-person perspective: **V**
• Hand brake: **S**
• Sit down: **K**
• Throttle acceleration 40%: **B**
• Raise the wheel: **CTRL**

📱 **Control (for mobile devices)** 
• Tap the button on the screen to control.
